2_about.verbatim_text: GMCA (Genius Mind Chess Academy) was formed in 2011 for the promotion of chess. We provide chess training in group or individual settings at all levels — Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced. We also organize chess tournaments to provide a competitive environment for our students.

why_chess_grid.desc: Develops deep focus and immunity to distractions during intense games and studies.
Enhances spatial memory and tactical pattern recognition.
Sharpens multi-step mathematical planning and problem-solving speed.
Encourages creative visualization of moves and future board positions.
Instills self-reliance and emotional resilience in competitive scenarios.
Teaches long-term goal setting and methodical execution.
Unlocks innovative tactics and out-of-the-box strategic thinking.
Refines risk evaluation and decision-making under pressure.
Trains disciplined allocation of clock time during matches.
Encourages ownership of outcomes and learning from every mistake.

cards.title: Beginner Classes
cards.desc: Master piece movements, basic rules, elementary checkmates, and tactical awareness.

cards.title: Group Classes
cards.desc: Interactive group learning fostering friendly competition, game analysis, and sparring.

cards.title: Kids Special Batches
cards.desc: Fun, engaging chess fundamentals tailored specifically for young children aged 5+.

cards.title: Professional & Advanced Chess
cards.desc: Deep opening preparation, endgame mastery, positional play, and FIDE rating strategy.

cards.title: Weekend Classes
cards.desc: Flexible weekend sessions designed for students with busy school schedules.
